text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I believed I was formulating and executing the optimal plan to secure victory...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And yet, if I can't get results...
is it because my process is wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Geez... I feel like I don't even
know what to do anymore...
choice_data_list: We can just figure it out together.
Even so, we just have to keep on running!
Even so, you just have to keep on running!

Even so, we just have to keep on running!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: At times like this, I want you to rely on me more.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: True, I wasn't running all by myself, was I?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Besides, a schedule is something that improves
every time you review and fix its flaws...!

When Eishin Flash lifted her head,
the fighting spirit had returned to her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: If you keep running, you'll definitely find the answer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You are absolutely right...
There's no point in lamenting and giving up on thinking.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
After all, there is no other way to grow stronger
than to keep on running...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Your harsh words opened my eyes. Thank you, Trainer.
